A whitespace-only span opening a div does not indent the image after it into a code block

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>P</p>\n<div>\n<span>    </span><img alt=\"A\" src=\"S\"/>\n</div>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
